```{=html}
(function () {
  var attributions = {
    'Getting Started': 'Photo by <a href="https://unsplash.com/@jbl12761?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">James Lee</a> on <a href="https://unsplash.com/photos/a-blurry-photo-of-a-person-running-_QvszySFByg?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Unsplash</a>',
    'Experimental Methods': 'Photo by <a href="https://unsplash.com/@ryigarry?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Unlimited Motion Ltd</a> on <a href="https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-black-shirt-standing-near-black-video-camera-whDe_UdHzo8?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Unsplash</a>',
    'Neural Control': 'Photo by <a href="https://unsplash.com/@acharki95?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Aziz Acharki</a> on <a href="https://unsplash.com/photos/photo-of-silhouette-photo-of-man-standing-on-rock-U3C79SeHa7k?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Unsplash</a>',
    'Muscle Mechanics': 'Photo by <a href="https://unsplash.com/@photosoflogan?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Logan Gutierrez</a> on <a href="https://unsplash.com/photos/meiji-techno-microscope-with-objective-lenses-Rl9bIWKCVF0?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText">Unsplash</a>'
  };
  function addAttribution() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-grid-item').forEach(function (card) {
      var titleEl = card.querySelector('.listing-title');
      if (!titleEl) return;
      var imgEl = card.querySelector('img');
      if (!imgEl) return;
      var wrapper = imgEl.parentElement;
      if (!wrapper.classList.contains('card-img-wrapper')) {
        wrapper.classList.add('card-img-wrapper');
      }
      var matchedKey = Object.keys(attributions).find(function (k) {
        return titleEl.textContent.includes(k);
      });
      if (!matchedKey || wrapper.querySelector('.img-attribution-overlay')) return;
      var overlay = document.createElement('div');
      overlay.className = 'img-attribution-overlay';
      overlay.innerHTML = attributions[matchedKey];
      wrapper.appendChild(overlay);
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', addAttribution);
  } else {
    addAttribution();
  }
})();
</script>
```
